name: urban-reference walking-speed alternatives
description: An explicitly out-of-domain, uncalibrated structural speed sweep informed by the source-locked VRU reference report.

factors.subject: passengers
factors.rationale: The values bracket the 0.565 m/s and 1.825 m/s fixed-histogram P50/P95 reported by the locked urban VRU adapter around this deliberately authored 1.2 m/s baseline. They expose structural sensitivity only and are not a fitted station parameter.

references.citation: Zernetsch, S., Kress, V., Bieshaar, M., Reitberger, G., Fuchs, E., Doll, K., & Sick, B. (2022). VRU Trajectory Dataset. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6303669
references.applicability: The source-locked Chiyoda VRU adapter reads publisher CSV pedestrian trajectories and reports broad, fixed-filter speed alternatives for disclosed structural exploration.
references.limitation: The data describe head-position trajectories at one urban intersection, including moving, starting, stopping, and waiting labels. They do not measure this concourse, station pedestrians, evacuation, route choice, queueing, body dimensions, or information behavior.

claim_boundary: This source-linked study only shows the deterministic reference runtime's response to explicit, out-of-domain structural alternatives. It does not estimate station walking speeds, calibrate the runtime, predict people, or support operational or safety claims.
